subject: Galileo Health — Security-driven infra recommendation & next steps
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@galileohealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: IT Security <secops@galileohealth.com>; Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@galileohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / quick follow-up on deployment constraints

Thanks for the demo earlier — that was helpful. A couple of clarifying items from our side: 1) our compliance team is clear that PHI cannot traverse third-party multi-tenant GPU pools without a signed BAA and SOC2 attestation; 2) latency to our primary region (us-west-2) needs to stay under ~120ms P99 for critical workflows.

At this point we want to understand the minimum evidence we need to get to a Dedicated or Private VPC decision: what SOC2 scope items you can share up front, and whether Redwood can support an isolated VPC with customer-managed keys. Also curious if there are options for a short-term hosted pilot while we finalize procurement.

Can you send a short checklist so our security team knows exactly what to validate?

— Samira
Director, Product 
Galileo Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@galileohealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / quick follow-up on deployment constraints

Thanks Samira — appreciate the clear asks. Quick recap and suggested plan from our side: 

1) Evidence and artifacts: we attached a one-page SOC2 summary (Redwood_SOC2-quicksummary.pdf) and a high-level architecture diagram (inference-architecture-options.png). The SOC2 summary lists the latest attestation date and scoping notes; we can share the full report under an NDA if needed.

2) Deployment options by security posture: 
- Hosted API: fastest to start (self-service), but for PHI requires a signed BAA and will be provisioned on our hosted plane (multi-tenant). Not recommended for long-term PHI unless you accept hosted with BAA + encryption-at-rest + strict routing.
- Dedicated capacity: single-tenant GPU pools reserved to your org, supported with customer VPC peering and optional dedicated tenancy in our cloud account — meets most enterprise PHI controls and simplifies latency in us-west-2.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): customer-managed control plane or on-prem bundle; highest isolation and required for customers with strict audit or air-gap requirements.

3) Short-term pilot path: we can provision a time-limited Dedicated pod with a restricted scope for a 4-week pilot (SLA-lite) — requires a short statement of work + procurement approval. That lets you validate latency and functionality before committing to a longer Dedicated contract or Private deployment.

Next steps I propose: 
- I’ll drop the SOC2 one-pager and a draft BAA for your legal/security review (attached).
- Rishi (cc'd) will follow up with a latency test plan and sizing estimate for a Dedicated pilot in us-west-2.
- Connor can set up a 30-min ops/architecture call next week with your secops team to walk the VPC/network options.

Are you available Tue/Wed next week for that call?

Best,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Healthcare 
Redwood Inference
Signature: +1 (415) 555-0199 | kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-quicksummary.pdf (pdf), inference-architecture-options.png (image), draft-BAA-galileo-v1.docx (docx)

From: Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@galileohealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@galileohealth.com>
Cc: IT Security <secops@galileohealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / quick follow-up on deployment constraints

Kimberly / Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from our security lead (copied):
- We need to confirm whether the Dedicated pod still routes any secrets or metadata through Redwood control plane (we prefer zero metadata egress).
- For a pilot we can accept a Dedicated pod with a limited BAA scope, provided we get a formal sign-off from Redwood on encryption key handling (KMS options) and audit log retention (minimum 12 months).
- Please include an estimate of expected token cost delta between Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for our sample workload (we’ll share sample prompts offline).

We can do Wed 6/30 at 10am PT for the ops call. Please send calendar invite.

— Arjun
Sr. Security Engineer 
Galileo Health

On Mon, Jun 28, 2027 at 07:45 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Looping Rishi and Connor in — we’ll prepare the artifacts and the pilot SOW draft. Confirming Wed 6/30 10am PT works; invite to follow.
> 
> — Kim

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@galileohealth.com>, Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@galileohealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Galileo Health — Security-driven infra recommendation & next steps

Thanks — short notes ahead of Wed's call so we can be efficient: 

1) Metadata & control-plane traffic: Dedicated capacity still uses Redwood's control plane for scheduling/telemetry, but we offer an option to disable non-essential metadata telemetry and to use private peering for control-plane channels. We will document exact endpoints and provide a network allowlist.

2) KMS options: we support customer-managed keys in AWS KMS (bring-your-own-key) and HSM-backed KMS via partner integrations. We'll provide a config checklist for key rotation and proof-of-possession.

3) Audit logs & retention: standard Dedicated retention is 90 days; enterprise add-on can extend to 24 months. For the pilot we can enable 12-month retention to match your ask. We’ll include the retention SLA in the pilot SOW.

4) Cost delta estimate: rough order-of-magnitude 
- Hosted API: baseline (lowest up-front), 
- Dedicated: +15–30% per-token vs hosted due to reserved GPU and isolation overhead, 
- Private/on-prem: +40%+ (integration + infra ops).

Please share a short sample workload (100k tokens/day, typical sequence lengths) and I’ll convert that into a pilot sizing and token-cost projection for the Wed call.

Action items before Wed 6/30 10am PT: 
- Galileo: send sample workload + primary SLs to validate (Arjun).
- Redwood: finalize pilot SOW draft and calendar invite (Kim).
- Redwood: circulate full SOC2 under NDA if legal requests it (Rishi).

Looking forward — Rishi
Principal Solutions Architect 
Redwood Inference
